* Can operate independently and carry projects forward with minimal direction

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Aerospace, defense, or hardware/manufacturing finance experience

Din Tai Fung is a globally celebrated, family-owned restaurant brand founded in 1972 and internationally renowned for its iconic Xiao Long Bao. With more than 165 locations across 13 countries including 20 in North America. DTF is Michelin-recognized and admired for its uncompromising quality, authentic flavors, and warm, gracious hospitality. jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, AD&S
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) division builds advanced autonomous air vehicles and munitions systems designed to deter, compel, and defeat adversaries at scale. Our portfolio — including platforms like Fury and Barracuda — spans high-performance multi-mission air vehicles purpose-built for contested environments and hyper-scale production. The AD&S Finance team provides the financial infrastructure to support programs as they scale from rapid development through production ramp, partnering with engineering, supply chain, and program leadership to maintain cost visibility and financial rigor across a fast-growing portfolio.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will provide dedicated program finance support to the Advanced Effects Business Line within the Air Dominance & Strike Division. This portfolio spans cutting-edge missile programs that are rapidly scaling from development into production. Your primary focus will be tracking and forecasting the cost build-up of hardware products — understanding how material, labor, and overhead flow through each stage of the product lifecycle and translating that into reliable baselines, forecasts, and variance analysis.  
  
You will work closely with Program Managers, Supply Chain, and Accounting to ensure cost visibility keeps pace with program execution. This role requires someone who can operate autonomously, drive projects from inception to completion, and communicate financial performance clearly to cross-functional stakeholders. You will also help the team navigate ongoing data and systems challenges as we mature our ERP and forecasting tool environments.  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own program-level cost forecasting and EAC/ETC development for hardware programs transitioning from development to production
* Build and maintain bottoms-up cost models that capture material, labor, overhead, and subcontract elements across the hardware build cycle
* Track actuals against baselines, identify variances, and drive root-cause analysis with program and supply chain teams
* Deliver monthly program financial reporting and present performance narratives to program management and business line leadership
* Partner with Supply Chain and Accounting to reconcile procurement activity, inventory movements, and cost postings
* Support the development and improvement of forecasting workflows in FP&A and ERP tools (Oracle, Anaplan, Foundry)
* Assist in pricing activities and proposal cost volume development
* Contribute to long-range planning and production rate ramp financial modeling
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting accuracy, data integrity, and process efficiency

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, program finance, or cost analysis — preferably in an environment that manufactures or integrates hardware
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Accounting, or related field
* Experience building or managing cost models for physical products (BOM-based costing, production cost build-ups, or similar)
* Strong understanding of how material, labor, and indirect costs flow through a manufacturing or defense program lifecycle
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and carry projects forward with minimal direction
* Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting financial narratives and variance explanations to non-finance stakeholders
* Proficiency with financial systems and data tools; experience with ERP platforms (Oracle preferred) is a plus
* Must be authorized to work in the United States

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* DoD industry experience or familiarity with government contract cost accounting (FAR/CAS)
* Security clearance (or ability to obtain one)
* Experience navigating ERP transitions or standing up new forecasting tools
* Exposure to supply chain or procurement finance

Per Anduril's expansion plans, we anticipate this job will be based out of Long Beach, CA beginning late 2027.

jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe’s Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to own headcount and operating expense (OpEx) finance across the company. This role is the single source of truth for how many people we have, how many we’re planning to hire, and what we’re spending outside of capital projects — and is responsible for the planning, budgeting, forecasting, and actuals reporting that keeps leadership and the business aligned on both. You’ll partner with People, Recruiting, and department leaders on headcount planning, own the OpEx budget process end-to-end, and make sure monthly actuals tell an accurate, timely story against plan.

This is a highly visible role for someone who wants to bring structure and rigor to how a scaling company manages its people and operating costs. This is a full-time, exempt position.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Headcount Planning & Tracking** — Own the headcount plan and forecast across the company, partnering with People and department leaders to track open reqs, hiring pace, and attrition against plan.
* **OpEx Budgeting & Forecasting** — Lead the annual budgeting and in-year OpEx forecasting process across departments, working with budget owners to build defensible, well-documented plans.
* **Actuals Reporting & Variance Analysis** — Own monthly and quarterly actuals reporting for headcount and OpEx, identifying variances to plan and partnering with budget owners on root cause and corrective action.
* **Forecast Management** — Maintain rolling headcount and OpEx forecasts, updating for approved changes, hiring plan shifts, and in-year business decisions.
* **Business Partnering** — Serve as the go-to finance contact for department leaders on headcount and OpEx questions, helping them understand their budgets and make informed trade-offs. Partner with HR on new or changing benefit ideas to improve employee experience, and with Marketing and other leaders on OpEx budgets/plans and associated ROI.
* **Process & Systems Improvement** — Improve the tools and processes used to plan, track, and report on headcount and OpEx, reducing manual reconciliation and increasing self-serve visibility for stakeholders.
* **Executive & Board Reporting** — Prepare clear, accurate headcount and OpEx reporting packages for executive leadership and the board.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
* 3+ years of progressive finance experience, including meaningful ownership of headcount and/or OpEx planning and reporting.
* Strong financial modeling skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive, Workday, or similar).
* Demonstrated ability to partner with People/Recruiting teams and translate hiring plans into financial impact.
* Track record of owning a budgeting and actuals reporting process end-to-end, including variance analysis and stakeholder communication.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over data accuracy — headcount and OpEx numbers get scrutinized by leadership every month.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain budget and variance drivers clearly to non-finance stakeholders.

**Bonus Points**

* MBA.

**Benefits:**

* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account

* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $130,000-$160,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

As a Crossroads Buyer, you will bring our brand promise to life: to offer a fun, fashion-centered, and affordable shopping experience to our communities. You’ll hand select items to sell in our stores and provide a high-level of customer service. You’ll get customers excited about shopping and selling second-hand fashion, whether it’s their first time or their 1000th!

When you join Crossroads, you are joining the sustainable fashion movement and reshaping fashion culture. And you aren’t just impacting the planet’s future- you are impacting your own.

* We have clear paths for promotion and several routes you can take as you embark on your second-hand retail journey.
* You’ll learn how to run a second-hand business– you’ll embody an entrepreneurial spirit- learning everything from buying, merchandising and inventory practices to gaining and maintaining the trust of a customer base who has been devoted since day one.

**You are:**

* **A Team Player**. You are as enthusiastic about the success of others as you are about your own success.
* **Authentic**. You are your unique self!
* **Fashion-focused.** You eat, breathe, and sleep style. Fashion is life.
* **Adaptable**. You feel comfortable adjusting to changing circumstances and encourage your teammates to do the same. We problem-solve together!
* **People**-**first**. You are energized by people. You radiate kindness and positivity! You understand your impact and are someone who uplifts others.

**You will:**

* **Engage**. You get to meet new people, every day! Greet each customer with a smile and welcome them to our store. Create a welcoming, fun, and inclusive environment to shop and work in.
* **Ask and Educate**. You will teach our customers how we work and get them excited about selling their clothes to us!
* **Have Integrity**. You will act with integrity in words and actions- do the right thing and do it right, even when it’s difficult.
* **Be Compassionate**. You will embody our core values of service, inclusion, and education. It’s important that we connect with all customers and try our best to help them.
* **Be Reliable**. You will show up to work on time and ready to go!
* **Be Flexible**. You understand that needs change and evolve throughout the day- you know how to support your team and customer as needed.
* **Enjoy Organizing.** Cleaning, organizing, and merchandising are all parts of the job and help create the best possible shopping and working environment.

**Perks:**

**Health + Wellbeing**

**We will:**

* **Support your wellbeing**. We care about our employees holistically and offer sick paid time off.
* **Prioritize wellness for all.** We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance for ALL employees who work at least 20 hours a week!

**Work/Life Harmony**

**We will:**

* **Give you incentives when you work during the holidays.** We pay time and a half on select holidays throughout the year, and we are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.
* **Encourage work/life balance.** We offer flexible scheduling so that you can meet work & life needs!

**Financial Health**

**We will:**

* **Contribute to your 401(k)**. Free money? We’ll match up to 4% of your contribution as soon as you enroll & an additional discretionary 2% at year-end! We offer both a Roth and traditional 401(k).
* **Offer** a generousdiscount on all merchandise including luxury consignment pieces- shop where you work!
* **Be Transparent.** We have clear pay ranges and always advertise pay for positions. We believe in pay equity.
* **Offer Earned Wage Access.** Need money before payday? You’ll be able to access pay as you earn it through our partner app ZayZoon
* **Contribute** **to Commuter Benefits**. Take public transit? We’ll contribute and match a portion of your commuter account monthly.

**Growth + Development**

**We will:**

* **Let you take the lead.** We offer clear paths for growth and ongoing professional development that are straightforward and attainable.
* **Celebrate with you**. We’ll provide you with many opportunities to bond with your team as you celebrate successes together.
* **Equip you with the tools to be successful**. As you onboard & throughout your career, our training programs will set you up to win.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Must be able to work a minimum of 12 hours per week.
* 6+ months of retail experience.
* Have a good eye for fashion and current trends.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

**About Crossroads**

One of the first companies to pioneer secondhand clothing as an alternative to traditional retail, Crossroads Trading has been buying, selling, and consigning name brand and designer clothing in a friendly, fun, and fashionable atmosphere since 1991.

Since opening the doors of its first location in the heart of San Francisco’s Fillmore District, Crossroads has expanded over time to 38 retail locations spanning Northern and Southern California, Chicago, Seattle, Portland, Denver, New York, and Houston. And in recent years, we have added Sell-By-Mail and Concierge programs to provide convenient new ways for fashionable and eco-conscious customers to sell their gently used clothing.

Crossroads has been featured in Harper’s Bazaar, Teen Vogue, and LA Mag, and is widely recognized as an industry leader in the ‘resale revolution.’

**If you like sustainability, fashion, and working in a fun, positive environment, you’ll enjoy a career with us!**

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst (Financing / Capital Markets)
jobs.description:
Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia.
  
  
To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/

**About the Role**
------------------

Bitdeer is seeking a **Senior Financial Analyst** to support financing and fundraising for GPU computing and data-center infrastructure. Based in San Jose, this role will work closely with the regional senior financing leader and cross-functional teams to develop models, evaluate funding alternatives, prepare transaction materials, and support execution. Direct GPU or Data Center experience is helpful but not required; the successful candidate will bring strong analytical skills and relevant experience from banking, credit, equipment finance, corporate finance, treasury, or another transaction-oriented environment.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
------------------------------------

* **Financial Modeling:** Build and maintain detailed financing, cash-flow, debt-service, and return models for GPU purchases and data-center projects.
* **Capital & Structure Analysis:** Analyze financing alternatives, including equipment loans, leases, asset-backed facilities, project financing, private credit, vendor financing, and other structured solutions.
* **Transaction Materials:** Prepare lender presentations, information packages, financial schedules, diligence responses, approval materials, and executive summaries.
* **Execution Support:** Support financing processes from market research and lender outreach through term-sheet evaluation, diligence, documentation, closing, funding, and post-close monitoring.
* **Covenant & Milestone Tracking:** Track project capital expenditures, funding availability, utilization, interest, fees, covenant requirements, payment schedules, and key financing milestones.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Finance, Treasury, Legal, Tax, Accounting, Operations, and Procurement to validate assumptions and maintain consistent source data.
* **Scenario Modeling:** Develop scenario analyses connecting GPU deployment, utilization, power and facility capacity, revenue, operating costs, capital expenditures, and liquidity.
* **Process & Controls Improvement:** Improve templates, reporting, controls, and data processes that support a scalable global financing function.
* **Market Intelligence:** Conduct market and comparable-transaction research on data-center, digital-infrastructure, equipment-finance, and AI-compute financing trends.
* **External Partnerships:** Support communications and execution activities with U.S. banks, equipment lessors, private-credit providers, infrastructure investors, and strategic partners.

**How You Will Stand Out**
--------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Typically 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in investment or commercial banking, corporate finance, project finance, equipment finance or leasing, credit, treasury, transaction advisory, or FP&A.
* **Technical Skills:** Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills, with strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
* **Data Management:** Ability to organize large volumes of financial and operational information and communicate conclusions clearly.
* **Execution & Detail:** Strong attention to detail, ownership, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work across functions, seniority levels, and geographies.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in data centers, GPUs, servers, technology hardware, energy, infrastructure, equipment leasing, or another capital-intensive sector.
* Experience supporting debt, lease, project-finance, private-credit, or asset-backed transactions.
* Familiarity with financial statements, credit agreements, covenant calculations, and financing-related accounting concepts.
* Mandarin proficiency is a plus but not required. The role will operate in English while collaborating with some colleagues and stakeholders in Asia.

Success will be measured by the quality and speed of financing execution, accuracy and transparency of financial analysis, strength of internal and external partnerships, and the ability to help Bitdeer fund GPU and data-center growth while maintaining disciplined economics and risk controls.

-
  
Bitdeer is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with country, state, and local laws. Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, color, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

jobs.title: FP&A Plant Controller
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**  
The FP&A Plant Controller plays a critical role in bridging financial planning and operational execution within the manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining dynamic standard costing models that align with budgetary targets, providing actionable insights to plant leadership, and ensuring financial transparency and control across operations. The Controller partners directly with plant managers to drive performance, improve margins, and support strategic decision-making.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Standard Costing & Budget Alignment

Develop, implement, and maintain dynamic standard costing models that reflect current operational realities and align with annual budgets and forecasts.
  

* Operational Partnership

Collaborate closely with plant managers and operational teams to understand cost drivers, identify efficiency opportunities, and ensure financial goals are integrated into daily operations.
  

* Financial Reporting & Analysis

Lead the preparation and analysis of monthly financial statements for assigned entities; explain variances, monitor key performance indicators, and provide recommendations to improve financial outcomes.
  

* Product Costing & Margin Analysis

Deliver detailed product costing and margin analysis to support pricing strategies, margin improvement initiatives, and cost optimization efforts.
  

* Inventory & Cost Accounting Oversight

Ensure accurate and timely reporting of inventory and cost accounting; validate standard costs, quantities, and valuations across manufacturing sites.
  

* Budgeting & Forecasting Support

Contribute to the annual budget and interim forecast processes, ensuring alignment between financial plans and operational capabilities.
  

* Process Improvement & Cost Savings

Identify and lead initiatives to improve financial processes and reduce costs, working cross-functionally with manufacturing, procurement, and finance teams.
  

* Ad Hoc Projects

Support additional tasks and strategic initiatives as assigned by leadership to advance departmental and organizational goals.
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA and/or MBA preferred.
* 5–7 years of experience in FP&A or plant controlling, ideally within a manufacturing environment.
* Strong understanding of ERP systems and cost accounting principles.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, financial modeling, and Microsoft PowerPoint.
* Proven ability to develop and implement financial systems and processes.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and analytical skills.
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management capabilities.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**  

* None

**Work Environment:**  
The work environment characteristics below are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of the job.
  
  
**Office & Manufacturing Settings:**  

* This role operates in both office and plant environments, requiring occasional exposure to manufacturing conditions including noise, temperature variations, and machinery. PPE may be required when on-site.

**Physical and Mental Demands:**  
The demands described are representative but not all inclusive of those demands that must be met by an employee (with or without reasonable accommodation) to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  

* Ability to operate standard office equipment and communicate effectively.
* Strong attention to detail and time management skills.
* Capacity to navigate plant environments safely and comply with safety protocols.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to carry out essential job duties.

**Job Description:**

**Job Title:** Senior Financial Analyst, Treasury

**Location:** Remote | USA, Canada
  
**Reports to:** Director, Treasury & Consolidation

**Employment Type:** Full-time

This is a new vacancy

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst, Treasury to join our Controllership organization. The role is primarily focused on Treasury Operations and is ideal for a strong treasury professional who wants to broaden their corporate finance experience. The position is highly cross-functional, partnering with Accounting, Tax, AP, AR, Payroll and FP&A, with additional development opportunities across Consolidated FP&A, Lender Relations and Special Projects.

**In this role, you will:**

**Treasury Operations**

* Support global cash and liquidity management across multiple legal entities, currencies and banking relationships. Own daily, weekly and monthly cash positioning and management reporting.

* Be the day-to-day point-person for banking operations. Including bank accounts, payments, corporate credit cards, merchant accounts, etc.. Partner with the larger organization on IT projects, KYCs, internal controls, signatories, and other banking related initiatives.

* Build, maintain and enhance the 13-week cash flow forecast; analyze receipts, disbursements, working capital drivers and forecast variances. Partner closely with AP, AR, Payroll, Tax and Accounting to coordinate legal entity funding requirements

* Manage surplus cash and support the investment portfolio, balancing liquidity, capital preservation and returns; monitor market rates, maturities, portfolio liquidity and cash yield. Revamp and operationalize a corporate investment policy statement.

* Administration of capital markets activity: interest elections, lender reporting, foreign exchange, ISDAs, liquidity analysis.

* Maintain and enhance Treasury Management System processes. Use Excel, Power Query, Claude and Power BI to automate treasury forecasting, reporting and analytics; improve data flows, controls, processes and data quality. Build out balance sheet KPI dashboards.

* Support a scalable finance organization; investigate new technologies, streamline processes, rationalize account structures and integrate new acquisitions.

**Corporate Finance**

* Support consolidated actuals, budgets and forecasts, including P&L, balance sheet and cash flow analysis.

* Build and maintain integrated three-statement financial models and perform variance, trend, scenario and sensitivity analysis.

* Partner with Controllership and FP&A to bridge accounting results to management reporting and forecasts.

* Participate in refinancings, M&A, and other corporate finance initiatives.

* Operationalize senior management and Board reporting. Help build the narrative for board, lenders, credit agencies and other 3rd parties.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field; CPA or CFA designation, or meaningful progress towards either.

* 3-5 years of relevant experience with demonstrated corporate Treasury experience and a strong understanding of liquidity, cash forecasting, banking and treasury operations.

* Familiarity with a fast-paced PE sponsored and/or publicly traded company. Knowledge of how a matrixed multinational finance org operates.

* Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, including the ability to build or work with integrated three-statement models.

* Strong systems aptitude with Power Query, Power BI or similar tools; TMS and NetSuite experience is an asset.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and cross-functional relationship skills with high attention to detail.

**Compensation and Benefits**

This position has a starting salary range of $99,000 - $132,000 USD or $87,000 - $111,000 CAD per year. Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

* **We make things easy.** We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.

**The Job:**

As a Trade Compliance Analyst, you’ll be part of our Global Trade Compliance team working as a remote employee. You’ll get to:

* Ensuring import transactions are executed in compliance with all applicable international trade regulations
* Conducting audits to ensure accurate declarations with various tools and software
* Reviews and assesses U.S. customs entries & declarations for accuracy and compliance with import regulations
* Engages Engineering, Purchasing, and other departments to streamline the collection of critical data
* Compares and verifies country of origin information received from businesses for certain products and projects
* Supports information requests between Trade Compliance and business stakeholders for external reviews

* Utilize critical thinking skills to understand root causes to resolve data discrepancies related to import transactions

* Continuously strives to improve business processes
Able to receive and apply feedback to enhance performance.

* Proficient with current Microsoft Office programs. Intermediate Excel proficiency preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Media Buyer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

As the Senior Media Buyer, you own the paid media strategy for the full brand portfolio — seven brands today, and every brand added after — not just the execution of it. You decide where portfolio media dollars go and why, set the testing roadmap, and are accountable for Giveaway Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER) across every brand.

You'll operate as a strategic partner to leadership on growth: bringing your own point of view on where to invest, where to pull back, and what's next, then building the plan to get there. This is a role for someone who thinks in portfolio terms first and campaign terms second and who's ready to grow into directing other buyers as the function scales.

**What You'll Own**

* Serve as the single accountable owner for Giveaway MER across every brand in the portfolio — the decision-maker on strategy, not just the person reporting on it
* Own portfolio-level budget allocation: decide how spend is distributed and reallocated across brands based on performance and opportunity, not just optimize within a budget someone else sets
* Deliver a weekly Target → Actual → Insights → Action performance report to leadership, translating results into a portfolio-level narrative and recommendation rather than a data dump
* Build and maintain a live Giveaway MER dashboard tracking first-time revenue, total spend, MER by brand, and opt-in rate
* Submit pre-giveaway strategy briefs ahead of each cycle: revenue goals, spend allocation by brand, and top testing priorities — as a proposal to leadership, not just a status update
* Design and direct a structured testing roadmap across creative, messaging, offer, and funnel variables, and turn results into portfolio strategy, not just test read-outs
* Act as strategic lead for the full portfolio, directing paid media strategy for a subset of smaller brands directly
* Deliver rolling 3-month projections covering revenue contribution, MER targets, and opt-in rate by brand, with scenario planning for how shifts in spend or performance change the picture
* Develop and maintain a paid media SOP and onboarding documentation: building the foundation to bring on buyers or an agency under your strategy as the role expands
* Partner cross-functionally with creative, CRO, and finance leads on the tradeoffs behind media decisions

**Not in Scope**

Email/SMS execution, website or platform development, fulfillment/warehouse/inventory operations, or reactive troubleshooting outside of paid media and growth functions — these are owned by other teams. Day-to-day campaign execution stays with this role for now; that's the first piece to hand off once a buyer or agency is brought on under this person's strategy.

**What We're Looking For**

* A track record of owning a KPI end-to-end across multiple brands or a portfolio, ideally in e-commerce, DTC, or performance marketing; not just executing someone else's media plan
* Comfort making and defending budget allocation calls across accounts, with the analytical rigor to back them up (you build and maintain your own dashboards and reporting)
* Experience designing and running structured A/B tests with clear hypotheses and success metrics, and translating results into strategy, not just test read-outs
* Excellent written communication; this role runs on clear, consistent reporting to leadership
* Self-directed and comfortable operating independently, with strong follow-through on deadlines
* Experience with giveaway, sweepstakes, or promotional contest marketing is a **strong plus**
* You surface problems, recommendations, and creative needs before someone has to ask you
* You're comfortable with direct feedback and high expectations
* You think ahead to what the function needs as it grows, even if you're the only person on it today

**Compensation & Structure**

* $70,000 to $85,000, based on experience
* The one non-negotiable is hitting deadlines and keeping the reporting cadence on time
* Full ownership of your growth path, with room for expanded scope over time (including directing other buyers as the function grows)

**Experience & Requirements**

* 3+ years owning paid media strategy and execution across multiple brands or accounts simultaneously, with experience managing significant daily spend (our current portfolio runs $100k+/day) — you'll still be hands-on until the function grows, but you're chosen for how you think about the portfolio, not just how you run a campaign
* Deep Meta Ads fluency: comfortable directing campaign architecture, conversion objectives, and consolidation strategy, and quick to translate platform changes into portfolio-level strategy shifts, not just tactical adjustments
* Experience with third-party attribution and reporting platforms (Hyros, Triple Whale, Supermetrics, Wicked Reports, or similar) is a plus; comfortable working across multiple data sources and picking up new attribution tools quickly
* Prior experience directing the work of other buyers, freelancers, or an agency is a plus

Pay: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

We are focused on fighting food insecurity, providing equity in education, making sure every child has the opportunity to experience the joy of sports, ensuring kids and teens have a safe place to grow, learn and live a healthy lifestyle. The LA Y’s health and wellness initiatives offer medical and mental health resources to ensure everyone has access to basic health needs. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Reviews and processes purchasing requests such as purchase requisitions and small purchase orders for goods or services to ensure compliance with the association’s purchasing procedures, the state procurement code, and user requirements.
* Provides liaison services between vendors and centers for order status, procurement procedures, and problem resolution.
* Researches sources of supply and advises on cost effective alternatives.
* Assists in bid openings for competitive solicitations such as requests for quotes, bids, and proposals.

* Maintains records in accordance with established policies and procedures and audit guidelines.

* Monitor usage inconsistencies, price changes, and vendor back orders.
* Validates, reconciles, and processes receiving reports, vendor invoices, and other payment documents.
* May lead, guide, and train staff as appropriate to the area of operation.

* **Attend** staff meetings and trainings as required.

* **Demonstrate** competencies in and willingness to develop in the Cause Driven Leadership areas of mission advancement, collaboration, operational effectiveness and personal growth.
* All other duties as assigned by your supervisor.

* **Mission Advancement-** advancing the Y’s promise to strengthen community Competencies include: Values, Community, Volunteerism, Philanthropy

  + Competencies include: Decision Making, Innovation, Project Management, Finance, Quality Result
* **Personal Growth-** developing continually to adapt to new challenges

  + Competencies include: Self Development, Change Capacity, Emotional Maturity, Functional Expertise

While all competencies are significant the following are critical to success in this position:

* Values
* Communication
* Quality Results
* Emotional Maturity

* **EDUCATION**: High school Diploma
* **RELATED EXPERIENCE:** 2 years working in purchasing or procurement, preferred
* **SPECIALIZED SKILLS:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work effectively with multiple centers and individuals. Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs, data entry, and word processing skills

**WORK ENVIRONMENT/MINIMUM PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Must have the physical, visual, and auditory ability to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodations.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS and ABILITIES

jobs.description:
Senior Financial Planning & Budget Analyst

  

**The Position:** The Senior Financial Planning & Budget Analyst is a full-time position reporting to the Manager of Decision Support. The role prepares organizational budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and long-range financial planning, with particular attention participant care costs, and utilization. Working with department leaders and executive management, the Senior Financial Planning & Budget Analyst translates financial and operational data into actionable recommendations that support organizational sustainability, growth, and informed strategic growth.

Success in this role is measured by budget and forecast accuracy, timely and actionable variance reporting, effective financial partnership with leaders, and measurable improvements in planning and reporting processes.

  

The annual pay range for the Senior Financial Planning & Budget Analyst position at Center for Elders' Independence is $104,332 to $159,629. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI's annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBLITIES:**

* Prepare the annual operating and capital budget and quarterly forecasts, integrating utilization, staffing, participant care costs, service-area assumptions, and strategic initiatives.
* Coordinate budget preparation activities with department managers and leadership teams
* Review budget submissions for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Develop and maintain budget and forecast models and planning tools.
* Analyze budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual results by PACE center, service area, program, and operational unit; distinguish drivers and recommend corrective actions or forecast changes.
* Provide detailed financial analyses, trend reports, and recommendations for management.
* Support strategic planning and business cases through scenario modeling and long-range financial projections for growth, expansion, capital investments, reimbursement changes, and other initiatives.
* Prepare and present financial reports, dashboards, and budget summaries for leadership.
* Monitor cost, utilization trends, and departmental spending and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.
* Provide guidance and training on budget policies, procedures, and financial best practices.
* Maintain documentation supporting budget assumptions and financial analyses.
* Support implementation and optimization of financial systems and reporting tools.
* Recommend enhancements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and transparency.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* A bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, economics, public administration, or a closely related field is required.
* Master's degree (MBA, MPA, or related field) preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive budgeting, FP&A, healthcare finance, reimbursement, or financial analytics experience
* 3 years' experience in healthcare, managed care, PACE, or Medicare Advantage, Medicaid preferred.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting principles, financial analysis, and forecasting methodologies.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and data analysis.
* Experience with ERP systems, budgeting software, Power BI, SQL, data warehouses or similar reporting tools. Experience with Adaptive WorkDay Adaptive Planning is preferred.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience of leading ITSMF tools (e.g. Service Now)

**Overview**
------------

As part of our FP&A team, you will play a key role in driving financial insights, shaping strategy, and supporting the long-term health of our platform. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to deliver clear, data-driven recommendations that help drive high-impact retention and member activation.

This high-visibility Finance role is designed for a technically strong professional who excels at bridging financial modeling with hands-on data exploration to uncover strategic insights. Positioned at the intersection of Finance and Data, you will blend FP&A rigor with analytics to directly influence lifecycle strategy and drive member engagement.

**Responsibilities**

**What you will do:**

* Own the financial reporting, forecasting, and planning for core engagement metrics (DAU, MAU, and retention cohorts) to ensure business stability and predictability
* Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Revenue teams to refine data models, metric definitions, and the scalability of lifecycle reporting
* Optimize the balance between user engagement and platform monetization, ensuring that product health translates into sustainable financial growth
* Develop real-time ML-driven forecasts based on granular user behaviors and propensity models to increase the precision of long-range planning
* Develop and track complex cohort-based models to identify opportunities in the member journey and quantify the long-term value of improved retention
* Build and maintain complex models to evaluate the ROI of retention initiatives, member reactivation campaigns, and product features designed to deepen user habituation
* Serve as an AI adoption champion across the Finance organization, identifying opportunities to leverage new tools to automate and scale reporting
* Write and execute your own SQL queries, owning data validation, metric definitions, and the integrity of underlying datasets
* Analyze trends across member funnels and unit economics, translating granular data into high-level strategic insights for senior leaders
* Act as the financial source of truth for Product, Marketing, and Analytics teams, ensuring alignment on key metrics and roadmap decisions, while proactively collaborating across functions and influencing stakeholders without direct authority to drive data-informed outcomes
* Improve the accuracy of forecasting by identifying emerging risks/opportunities in member behavior and building scalable, automated data workflows

**What we would like to see:**

* Experience building forecasting frameworks that incorporate cohort-based retention, churn logic, and activation velocity
* Experience in leveraging ML-driven models (e.g., churn propensity, LTV predictions) to inform forecasting and lifecycle strategy
* A proven ability to dive into a dataset out of pure curiosity, but the discipline to only present the insights that actually drive business impact
* High proficiency in SQL, GSuite/Excel, and data tools (Databricks, Qlik, Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
* Experience with advanced AI forecasting tools (e.g., Cursor, Jupyter)

TITLE: Asset Management Analyst

REPORTS TO: Director of Asset Management

DEPARTMENT: Asset Management

STATUS: Regular, full-time (40 hours/week)

FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt

WAGE RANGE: $37.83 – $41.17/hour

GRANT FUNDED: No

UNION POSITION: Yes

LOCATION: 145 Taylor Street, San Francisco CA 94102

SCHEDULE: Hybrid work arrangement with in-office presence determined by management and business needs, including meetings and travel requirements.

**SUMMARY**

The Asset Management Analyst supports the Asset Management Department, including the Director of Asset Management and the Asset Managers, in overseeing TNDC’s varied and complicated affordable housing portfolio.

This role primarily helps evaluate property performance; supports budgeting and forecasting; manages funder relationships, and reports to stakeholders. This position assists with audit preparation, data compilation and analysis, new development project hand-off to asset management, and capital planning activities to support the portfolio. The Analyst contributes to long-term asset strategies that preserve and strengthen our communities. This role handles multiple tasks, many with specific deadlines, across the entire portfolio of TNDC properties and works with all members of the Asset Management Team. This role handles multiple time-sensitive projects simultaneously.

The Analyst also contributes to the overall organization and effectiveness of the Asset Management division, including maintaining file organization and naming conventions, supporting administrative processes, and helping ensure efficient day-to-day operations. This type of work will occupy no more than 25% of the Analyst’s overall role and responsibility.

This job description should not be interpreted as all inclusive. It is intended to identify the essential functions and requirements of this position. The incumbent may be requested to perform job-related responsibilities and tasks other than those stated in this job description.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

**Portfolio Performance and Operations**

* Provide analytical and operational support across the Asset Management department and its affordable housing portfolio, including portfolio and property-specific data requests, compilation, and analysis as needed.
* Support monitoring of property performance against annual asset management plans, budgets, and long-term asset strategies. Participate in interdepartmental meetings to review portfolio performance and maintain up-to-date notes, data, and variance analysis to help track progress.
* Help maintain individual asset management plans and support Asset Managers in tracking progress toward strategic goals, including recapitalizations and property repositioning plans, refinancings, and other asset-level transactions.
* Assist with evaluating and planning affordability compliance milestones, including properties approaching the end of affordability periods, to support preservation strategies and long-term asset decision-making.
* Provide support for lender and investor-related compliance and reporting and governmental filings pertaining to the portfolio, manage relationships with asset management reporting points of contact for multiple funders and public agencies.

**Financial Analysis, Reporting, and Strategic Support**

* Collect and centralize monthly and quarterly financial results for the Asset Management Team, including variances to budget, trends, and key operating metrics. Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

The analyst will create scalable reporting and planning processes for go-to-market spend and headcount, and will present insights to senior leadership, and to investors and the Board when needed.

* Model ROI for new channels, campaigns, partnerships, and sales initiatives, and run 'what-if' scenarios for budget reallocation
* Act as a trusted advisor to Marketing and Sales, challenging spend and prioritizing investments based on return
* Produce monthly go-to-market performance reporting and dashboards (CAC, cost per funded deal, conversion rates, ROAS)
* Partner with Accounting on marketing accruals, prepaid spend, and commission calculations so the month-end close is accurate
* Partner with Marketing Analytics and Data teams to reconcile spend data from ad platforms with the general ledger, and set a single source of truth for go-to-market metrics

* Experience with Netsuite ERP or Netsuite Planning and Budgeting software preferred

  

Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region | Location | Market Salary):

* Tier 2 | Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara & Washington DC | $110,200 - $121,800
* Tier 3 | All other US metro areas | $104,500 - $115,500

This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job-related factors, to determine final compensation.

  

Location Requirement: This is a remote position. However, candidates must reside in one of Point's states of operation: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

### **Our benefits**

* **Unlimited paid time off:** Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays.
* **Flexible remote and onsite work:** Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ.

In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. jobs.title: Financial Analyst & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Analyst & Project Manager works directly with senior leadership and carries each assignment from initial valuation through close of escrow.  
  
The Analyst & Project Manager executes projects across five areas:  
  

* Financial analysis
* Design
* Marketing
* AI process improvement

  
Much of the team’s analytical and production work is powered by proprietary internal technology. The person in this seat is not expected to build every model by hand or use traditional underwriting models. Instead, they:  
  

* Direct these systems
* Review every output with a critical eye
* Correct errors before anything reaches leadership or a client
* Continually engage in process improvement

  
In addition to day-to-day assignments, the successful candidate will take on projects that advance the vision of the brokerage unit, and the scope of the role will expand as the business grows.  
  
The hourly range for this role is $35.00 – $40.00 per hour. Actual pay will be determined by factors such as education, experience, and job-related skills relevant to the role. Marcus & Millichap is a multi-state employer and posted salary ranges are provided in good faith for compliance with all relevant pay-transparency regulations. These ranges may not reflect potential compensation for positions based in other states or regions.

**Responsibilities**

* Select and vet sale, lease, and on-market comparables for each assignment, and assemble the submarket data that feeds the team’s AI-powered tools. The quality of these inputs determines the quality of the valuation.
* Direct the underwriting tool through cash flow, cap rate, IRR, owner-user, land residual, and sensitivity analysis, and review each output carefully to confirm that assumptions, calculations, and conclusions are sound.
* Translate the analysis into a written pricing recommendation for leadership approval and explain and defend the reasoning behind it to senior leadership and clients.
* Produce listing proposals, Broker Opinions of Value, Offering Memorandums, flyers, and client deliverables using the team’s proprietary technologies, ensuring every page is accurate, on-brand, and client-ready.
* Prepare weekly Marketing Status Reports and client update emails that clearly communicate campaign activity, buyer interest, and next steps for every active listing.
* Develop marketing copy for offering memorandums, email campaigns, and listing pages that presents each property’s investment story clearly and persuasively.
* Build and send email campaigns to the team’s proprietary database, and publish and maintain listings on the team website, LoopNet, and other platforms.
* Create content for clients and social media on financial analysis, economic and market commentary, submarket intelligence, and case studies drawn from the team’s transactions.
* Plan and coordinate each listing launch across email, listing platforms, and social media on a defined timeline, so every channel goes live accurately and on schedule.
* Manage the team’s content calendar and oversee social media rollouts from concept through publication, including graphics and short-form video.
* Coordinate agents, clients, photographers, and outside vendors, and keep senior leadership informed on the status of every rollout.
* Guide the team’s AI models with clear direction, context, and examples to produce superior analysis, writing, and design, and recognize when an output falls short and how to correct it.
* Serve as the quality-control checkpoint for AI-generated work, minimizing errors and ensuring every deliverable meets the team’s standard before it is released.
* Identify bottlenecks in the analysis, design, and marketing workflows, and help build and refine AI agents and automations that increase the team’s capacity and underwriting depth.
* Take on new projects and initiatives that advance the vision of the brokerage unit, including work that falls outside the core responsibilities of the role.
* Manage several projects at once, maintain checklists and deadlines for each, and reprioritize decisively as the business evolves.

**Qualifications**

We are seeking a strategic, detail-driven, and entrepreneurial professional who understands commercial real estate, thinks critically about the work in front of them, and knows how to get the best out of AI tools.

  

* 2–5 years of experience in commercial real estate, financial analysis, or a closely related field
* General fluency in commercial real estate concepts, including valuation, NOI, cap rates, IRR, and leases, and how interest rates and submarket conditions influence pricing
* Demonstrated fluency with Claude and other AI tools
* Exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined approach to quality control
* Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to recognize what a stronger output looks like and how to get there
* Proficiency in Excel and comfort reviewing financial models
* Working proficiency in Adobe InDesign and Creative Cloud
* Strong written communication and presentation skills
* An entrepreneurial mindset and a willingness to take on any task that helps build the business

**Preferred**

* Investment sales brokerage experience
* Familiarity with CoStar and the mainstream CRE brokerage platforms

* Experience planning or coordinating marketing and social media campaigns
* Experience building workflows and tools with Artificial Intelligence

They must be skilled in building predictive models, running simulations, and utilizing advanced data collection techniques to guide acquisitions under constrained budgets.

Ability to perform a broad range of cost research/analyses in support of SYDs/PAEs by developing methodologies for evaluating cost effectiveness of advanced weapon systems. Ability to apply qualitative techniques and develop, adapt, modify, and apply cost models to solve problems, or define and clarify alternative solutions for management. Ability to effectively communicate results.

jobs.title: Senior Program Financial Analyst, AD&S
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's Autonomous Airpower (AA) business line develops and manufactures next-generation unmanned aircraft for U.S. and allied air forces. The AA program finance team is embedded with engineering, program management, and operations to ensure that every dollar of contract value is planned, executed, and reported with discipline. We are building a modern program controls function from the ground up: fast-moving, data-driven, and tightly integrated with the technical teams actually building the aircraft.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As a Senior Program Financial Analyst, you will own the financial health of one or more AA contracts end-to-end. You'll partner daily with Program Managers, Engineering Leads, and the broader Finance/Accounting organization to build bottoms-up forecasts, maintain contract budget baselines, execute earned value reporting, and drive margin performance. This role sits at the intersection of FP&A and Program Controls — you will spend as most of your time creating and managing financial models in Excel as you will working strategically with cross-functional partners. You will validate your data analysis and upload in Oracle, and using generative AI to find way to automate and streamline buiness processes. You should be comfortable defending your numbers to program leadership and translating program execution risk into financial impact.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own contract-level financial management across assigned AA programs, including monthly EAC / ETC development and cost/schedule variance analysis
* Maintain the contract value baseline in Excel/Oracle — navigating through varying contract types (FFP/CPFF), BCWS phasing based on labor and nonlabor inputs, reforecasting processes and change control, and monthly status reports
* Partner with Program Managers and Engineering Leads to build and challenge bottoms-up forecasts for remaining work (labor hours, materials, subcontracts, ODCs)
* Prepare monthly program financial reviews, including profit margin and gross margin surveillance, monthly and cumulative actuals-to-forecast variance explanation, and funding/billing position
* Reconcile monthly billings to cost performance; support unbilled AR, revenue recognition inputs, and month-end close deliverables
* Track and analyze unit cost trends versus forecast, and surface drivers to program and engineering leadership
* Support pricing, proposals, and ROM estimates for contract modifications and follow-on work
* Build and maintain reporting in Oracle, Anaplan, and Foundry to automate recurring program financial deliverables
* Contribute to long-range planning and the annual operating plan for the AA business line
* Drive continuous improvement in program controls tools, templates, and procedures

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3-5 years of experience in program finance, program controls, FP&A, or a related finance/accounting role
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong Microsoft Office and Excel modeling skills and comfort working with large datasets
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills
* Must be a U.S. citizen and be eligible to apply for and maintain a U.S. security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* DoD / aerospace & defense industry experience, particularly on cost-type (CPFF, CPIF) or FFP development contracts
* Exposure to Earned Value Management (EVM) concepts — CPI/SPI, BCWS/BCWP/ACWP, VAC, EAC/ETC
* Hands-on experience with Deltek Cobra, Oracle Fusion, Oracle EPM, or equivalent program controls / ERP tooling
* Familiarity with FAR/DFARS and CAS-covered contracting environments
* Experience supporting proposals, BOEs, or should-cost analysis
* Experience using Databricks, Foundry, and Claude Cowork/Code

We are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, part of a group of companies that meets the highest standards for using business as a force for good. We have more than 500 Prometheans, and have a home office in San Mateo, with satellite offices in Portland, Oregon, and in the Bay Area. Prometheus has a long history of award-winning approaches to what we do, receiving over 100 awards for design and excellence including Fortune Magazine's list of 100 Best Small & Medium Companies, the 100 Best Workplaces for Women and Best Places to Work in the Bay Area.

Lam’s Services organization is advancing service and support solutions such as self-maintaining equipment, self-aware systems, self-adaptive processes, and collaborative robots (Dextro™), using expanded data and automation capabilities to help customers build the fabs of the future. jobs.title: Administrative Analyst - Budget & Purchasing
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

**Bring your skills. Support the work that keeps San Ramon running.**

The City of San Ramon Public Works Department is looking for an analytical, detail-oriented professional to manage the budgets, purchasing, and contracts behind the City’s roads, parks, facilities, and public spaces. If you like turning numbers into decisions and making systems work better, your work here will show up across the community every day.

**The immediate opening is in the Public Works Department.**

**However, the eligibility list established from this recruitment will be used to fill future citywide Administrative Analyst vacancies, as appropriate.**

Public Works plans, builds, and maintains the City’s infrastructure through three divisions. Engineering delivers capital projects, Transportation keeps people moving safely around town, and Public Services maintains parks, roadways, creeks and drainage, landscaping, City facilities, and aquatics centers.

Reporting to the Administrative Program Manager in the Public Services Division, this position is the lead for developing and managing the Public Works Department’s operating budget. You’ll build, track, and report on the budget across all three divisions and multiple funds; oversee purchasing activity; manage accounts payable and receivable; and review RFPs, construction bids, and contracts for accuracy before they go out. The role also interprets purchasing policies, cooperative contracts, and prevailing wage requirements, and may support the department’s Capital Improvement Plan and grant administration. Experience with public agency operating budgets and purchasing is highly desirable.

**Ideal Candidate**

* You’re a public sector budget professional who’s comfortable building, monitoring, and forecasting an operating budget across multiple divisions and funds. You understand how field operations, revenues, and long-term needs like equipment replacement and aging infrastructure shape where the money goes, and you can explain it clearly to people who don’t live in spreadsheets.
* You have purchasing and contract experience, or a real interest in learning it. You read a scope of work, bid package, or contract with a careful eye and catch issues before they become problems. Familiarity with formal bidding, cooperative purchasing, or prevailing wage is a plus.
* Experience supporting capital projects or grants is a plus, including tracking CIP budgets and project spending alongside Engineering, keeping grant-funded work on schedule for reporting and reimbursement, and making sure the paperwork holds up to an audit.
* You’re an approachable, responsive resource for managers and supervisors across Engineering, Transportation, and Public Services. You enjoy helping people work through budget and purchasing questions, ask thoughtful questions, and look for ways to make the process simpler for the next person.
* You’re strong with Excel and financial systems, building trackers, reports, and dashboards people actually use, and spotting spending or contract trends before they turn into surprises.
* You’re a clear writer and presenter who can turn policies, regulations, and financial data into plain-language guidance, and present with confidence to department leadership, executive staff, and City Council when needed.
* You’re flexible and creative. You adapt when priorities shift (and in Public Works, they will), spot opportunities to improve budget and purchasing processes, and bring practical ideas to complex financial challenges.
* You’re organized and self-directed, able to juggle the budget cycle, purchase requests, and contract renewals at the same time and take a project from start to finish on your own.
* You’re a teammate who will collaborate and build trust with field staff, Finance, the City Attorney’s Office, and the City Clerk, and value relationships as much as results.

  
**DEFINITION**
  
Under general direction, provides varied, complex and confidential management and operational analysis in support of a department, division or program(s); analyzes practices, procedures and data including financial and geospatial; and makes recommendations for organizational, operational, financial, policy, staffing, and procedural improvements; conducts needs analyses, feasibility studies, and evaluations for assigned projects and programs; oversees and administers a variety of projects, grants and contracts; provides technical advice to staff, other departments, the public and other agencies; and performs related work as required.
  
  
**SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED**
  
Receives general direction from assigned supervisory or management personnel. May provide general supervision, direction and training over assigned professional, technical and administrative staff within assigned department.
  
  
**CLASS CHARACTERISTICS**
  
This is the first professional level within the administrative series. Incumbents support departmental management staff by conducting organizational, managerial, and operational analyses and studies. Incumbents develop and implement policies and procedures for a variety of projects and programs within an assigned department, including budget administration, contract administration, complex data or financial analysis, and program evaluation. Successful performance of the work requires the ability to work independently and perform complex analyses and research. This class is distinguished from the Administrative Coordinator in that the latter primarily organizes and oversees day to day program or office administration. It is further distinguished from the Program Manager in that the latter oversees and manages one or more program areas.

The Senior Financial Analyst, Capital Markets provides highly specialist high-level financial analysis and accounting-related services to senior organizational leadership as a member of the Capital Markets Management team. This position reports to the Director of Capital Markets & Tax Management.

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

The Senior Financial Analyst, Capital Markets is responsible for providing highly specialized services in one or more of the following functions: financial analysis and reporting; financial management; Profit & Loss accounting; or similar financial activities for the Capital Markets Management team, and across multiple business segments within the Global Finance business unit as well as business units outside of Global Finance. The Senior Financial Analyst, Capital Markets is a subject matter expert in these areas of specialization and serves as a resource to the organization or their organizational unit, as applicable, including as an advisor to senior and executive level staff. The position administers and maintains finance activities in accordance with TNC policies and procedures, relevant legal and regulatory frameworks, and financial/management best practice. jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, Financial Systems: Oracle EPM and FP&A
jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Senior Analyst, Oracle EPM & FP&A Systems (remote)is the technical subject matter expert responsible for the design, administration, and optimization of Oracle's Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) environment — the platform that powers our Medicare Advantage financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and long-range strategic modeling. Working at the intersection of technology and finance, this role partners directly with the FP&A team, Corporate Finance leadership, and the Senior Director of Enterprise Financial Systems to ensure that planning models, data pipelines, and reporting tools are accurate, performant, and built to support agile decision-making throughout the annual planning cycle and beyond.
  
  
In a Medicare Advantage organization, where annual CMS bid submissions, medical cost forecasting, and Stars/Risk Adjustment financial modeling depend on precise, real-time planning data, this role is a critical enabler of both financial performance and regulatory integrity.

**Job Duties / Responsibilities**

*May include but are not limited to*

**1. Administer and Optimize the Oracle EPM Planning Environment**  
Manage, configure, and continuously improve the Oracle Cloud EPM (Planning & Budgeting / PBCS/EPBCS) or Hyperion Planning/Essbase environment to ensure it remains stable, performant, and aligned with evolving business requirements. Design and maintain complex Business Rules, Calculation Scripts, and Member Formulas that power driver-based planning models, ensuring that Finance users can plan with speed and confidence across all budget and forecast cycles.

**2.****Maintain****Data Integrity Between ERP and EPM Systems**  
Architect and sustain automated data pipelines between Oracle Fusion Cloud GL and EPM Planning cubes using Data Management (FDMEE) or the EPM Integration Agent, ensuring a single, trusted version of financial actuals flows into every planning scenario. Manage the synchronization of key dimensions — including Entity, Cost Center, Product, and Plan Type — across ERP and FP&A systems so that metadata remains consistent and audit-ready at all times.

**3. Deliver Advanced Analytics and Executive Reporting**  
Build and maintain executive-level dashboards, Web Forms, and Narrative Reports using Oracle EPM Infolets and Financial Reporting Studio, giving Finance leadership real-time visibility into budget versus actuals, rolling forecasts, and long-range plan performance. Support FP&A analysts with Smart View configuration and best practices, enabling deep-dive multidimensional analysis while protecting the integrity of the underlying planning models.

**4. Enable Strategic Scenario Modeling and Forecasting**  
Support the technical configuration of Oracle Predictive Planning and Auto-Predict features to enhance forecast accuracy across medical costs, revenue, and enrollment projections. Assist Finance in building "what-if" technical scenarios for strategic events — including market entry, benefit design changes, or CMS payment rate adjustments — providing the technical infrastructure that transforms financial strategy into actionable model outputs.

**5. Ensure Security, Governance, and SOX Compliance**  
Maintain strict cell-level security, security filter design, and data access controls within Oracle EPM to protect sensitive payroll, compensation, and strategic financial data from unauthorized access. Ensure all metadata changes, script modifications, and system configurations are thoroughly documented to satisfy SOX audit requirements and internal governance standards.

**6. Provide Tier 3/4 Escalation Support and System Reliability**  
Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex incidents involving Oracle EPM — including Essbase cube failures, calculation errors, data load issues, and planning model discrepancies — during critical periods such as the annual budget cycle and quarterly forecast submissions. Drive root-cause analysis, implement preventive controls, and maintain clear runbook documentation to minimize recurrence and protect planning continuity.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct supervisory responsibility. The incumbent is expected to provide technical mentorship to junior analysts and may serve as the technical lead for EPM-related project workstreams during the Oracle implementation.

**After-Hours & Business Continuity Support**

The annual budget cycle and quarterly forecast submissions do not pause for weekends.

* This position is expected to participate in an on-call rotation to support critical EPM system failures, data load issues, and calculation errors outside of standard business hours.

* The incumbent must be available for elevated support during peak planning windows — including Annual Operating Plan (AOP) season, quarterly forecast cycles, and CMS bid preparation periods — when EPM system reliability is directly tied to regulatory and financial deliverables.

**Job Requirements**

**Experience**

**Required:**

* 6+ years of hands-on technical experience with Oracle EPM Cloud (PBCS/EPBCS) or Hyperion Planning/Essbase, with demonstrated focus on supporting FP&A business units

* Proven experience designing, building, and troubleshooting Essbase (ASO and BSO) multidimensional models, Business Rules, Calc Scripts,
