jobs.title: Junior Media Buyer
jobs.description:
**KittySpout / DoggySpout** is looking for a hungry **Junior Media Buyer** to join our team! You will launch every approved ad fast and right, and manage budgets, campaigns and ads across Facebook, Google, AppLovin, TikTok and Snapchat, following our SOPs. This is a growth seat: you work directly with our Head of Growth and learn from them day in, day out.

We spend **$2,500,000+ per month on paid media**, so you'll get more reps in a month than most buyers get in a year. We are looking to hire someone with **1–3 years** of Meta media buying, with Facebook as their main specialty. The ideal candidate is hungry, humble, gets the details right every time, and wants to grow from Junior Media Buyer to Media Buyer, Senior Media Buyer and Head of Paid/Growth.

### **The mission of this role**

Launch every approved ad fast and right, and manage budgets, campaigns and ads across Facebook, Google, AppLovin, TikTok and Snapchat (about $2.5M+ a month), following our SOPs. Success is ads live within 24 hours, budgets surfed and scaled through the day, and spend and CPA targets hit consistently. The path is Junior Media Buyer Media Buyer Senior Media Buyer Head of Paid/Growth, earned by consistently hitting spend and CPA targets.

### **Who are we?**

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

### **What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday** – improve one thing in the buying process each week and write it into the SOPs.
* **Speed Is King** – launch within 24 hours, and check and scale budgets every couple of hours.
* **Work Smart** – AI and automation first. Use AdManage, Claude and automations for launching and admin, and spot tasks that can be automated.
* **Overdeliver** – bring the Head of Growth the problem and the fix before being asked.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

### **Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Approved ads launch within 24 hours, correctly named and formatted – time from strategist handover to live (Asana, AdManage)
* Budgets are surfed and scaled every couple of hours across every channel – spend pacing vs plan by channel (ad platforms, Northbeam)
* Ads and campaigns are optimised daily and spend and CPA targets are hit consistently – spend vs plan and nCPA by channel (Northbeam)
* Every account is checked daily and big changes are logged – daily account check, Northbeam comments log
* Media buying processes are written down – SOPs written and kept up to date, so daily admin can be delegated or automated

### **Key Objectives**

* Launch approved ads, Trybe creator ads, landing pages and funnel tests every day – on time and launch-ready.
* Manage budgets, campaigns and ads across Facebook, Google, AppLovin, TikTok and Snapchat.
* Surf and scale budgets every couple of hours, and run the daily budget reset at about 2am EST.
* Check every ad account daily in Northbeam, optimise to our SOPs and log big changes.
* Write and improve our media buying SOPs so daily admin can be delegated or automated.
* Learn from the Head of Growth every week and apply the feedback the next day.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, full-time
* Fluent in English
* **Meta Media Buying:** About 2 years (1–3) of hands-on Meta media buying is a must – Facebook is your main specialty and you understand it well.
* **Time Zone & Availability:** Available at about 2am EST for the daily budget reset.
* **Attention to Detail:** You get naming and formatting right every time.
* **Reliable:** You do the daily checks and budget resets every day, without being chased.
* **Ready to Learn:** You learn quickly, ask for the why behind each decision, take feedback well and apply it the next day. No ego.
* **Long-Term Mindset:** You want to work side by side with a senior buyer and see this as the start of a path to Head of Paid/Growth.
* **Tools:** Comfortable with Meta Ads Manager, and quick to pick up AdManage, Northbeam, Asana and AI tools like Claude.
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
* Bonus points: experience on Google, TikTok, AppLovin or Snapchat; Shopify DTC or pet brand experience.

### **Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Launching** – Launch ads daily from the Asana launch tasks using AdManage and Claude, launch Trybe creator ads, landing pages and funnel tests, relaunch ads into new ad accounts and create new Facebook pages when strategists request them. Send back anything that isn't launch-ready.
* **Budgets and campaigns** – Manage budgets, campaigns and ads across Facebook, Google, AppLovin, TikTok and Snapchat, surf and scale budgets every couple of hours, and run the daily budget reset at about 2am EST.
*

Remote (US)

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Product R&D

**Compensation**
----------------

* Base Salary = $190K – $230K

At G2, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. That's why our compensation program is rooted in market data, transparency, fairness, and individual performance.

Compensation in an offer is determined by factors such as the candidate’s experience, relevant skills, and job-related knowledge.

We’ve built a company-wide framework to provide employees clarity on how compensation and success is measured at each level. This career framework supports our employees' professional growth and guides them to their PEAK.

We also support our employees by offering generous benefits, such as flexible work, ample parental leave, and unlimited PTO. Click here to learn more about our benefits.

  

**About G2 - The Company**

G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.

Now, we have joined forces with Capterra, SoftwareAdvice, and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.

And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.

Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!

**About G2 - Our People**

At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (*P*erformance + *E*ntrepreneurship + *A*uthenticity + *K*indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.

You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.

**About The Role**
------------------

More than 100 million software buyers use G2 each year to decide what to buy. AI has compressed discovery, but it has not made software easier to buy. Buyers now spend more time evaluating than researching, face a higher burden of proof, and increasingly start with an AI assistant before they ever reach a review site. G2 has the data, the reviews, and the audience to be the trusted place where that decision gets made. We need a product leader to build the experience.

As Principal Product Manager, Buyer Products, you will own the buyer experience across G2.com, G2.ai, and our Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp properties. This is a consumer-grade product role inside a B2B marketplace, with a GM mindset: you are accountable for the business outcome, not a feature backlog. Your charter is to turn anonymous traffic into known, returning buyers, and to turn those buyers into the highest-quality demand in B2B software.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for a builder who sets the strategy, ships in the product alongside Engineering and Design, and raises the bar for the PMs around them.

**In This Role, You Will:**
---------------------------

**Strategy and Roadmap**

* Own the product vision, roadmap, and operating metrics for Buyer Products. Make clear bets, sequence them, and say what we will not build.
* Start from the buyer. Obsess over what helps someone make a confident software decision, and treat their trust as the long-term asset.
* Make business tradeoffs when they matter. Understand how the buyer experience supports G2's business, and work with Marketing, Sales, Finance, and monetization teams to balance buyer value against revenue.

**Build and Ship**

* Lead discovery, define requirements, and drive delivery with Engineering and Design. Prototype, write specs, and ship changes yourself with AI-native tools where it creates speed.
* Run a high-cadence experimentation program. Define hypotheses, read results, and make ship, iterate, or kill decisions quickly with Data Science and Analytics.
* Work in small, AI-enabled squads with a bias toward shipping and learning over planning.

**Buyer Insight**

* Be the company's expert on how buyers research and evaluate software, including how AI assistants change that process. Run continuous qualitative and quantitative research, including with senior buyers.
* Translate buyer signals into product decisions and a clear narrative for the executive team.

**Leadership**

* Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Revenue teams around one buyer strategy.
* Mentor PMs, help set the hiring bar, and shape how the PM organization operates.

---------------------------

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

* 10+ years of product management experience, including Principal- or lead-level ownership of a major consumer-facing product.

The individual serves as a trusted partner driving invoicing and contracting needs with a focus on Healthcare Providers (HCP) and doing so with professionalism, sound judgment, and leadership presence.

  
  

**How you'll make an impact** :

  
  

Success in this role requires exceptional communication, attention to detail, and relationship management skills, with the ability to engage confidently and directly in challenging conversations while maintaining credibility and respect. Bachelor's Degree in in related field with 1 year of previous related experience in contract or bid management or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria Required

* Good knowledge and understanding of Edwards policies, procedures and guidelines relevant to contract or bid management

jobs.title: Corporate and Strategic Finance, FP&A
jobs.description:
The Finance team at Asana tracks and seeks to understand the factors driving our growth and success. We help our entire organization achieve our operational and financial goals while embodying our company values. We ensure our objectives are feasible and work closely with all teams to ensure they have the resources they need to achieve our ambitious mission enabling all teams to work together effortlessly.

We are looking for a Corporate and Strategic Finance Manager to join our FP&A team. In this role, you will strategically assess our growth drivers and partner closely with our Go-To-Market (GTM) teams to drive business impact. As a finance professional, you will solve complex problems independently, perform deep financial analysis, and partner directly with senior leadership.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

### **What you'll achieve**

* Solve problems analytically by gathering and summarizing large data sets to drive efficient executive decision-making and lead end-to-end recommendation processes.
* Nurture deep, trusted partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Product, Accounting, IT, and Business Operations teams.
* Support strategic short- and long-term business decisions through ROI-focused financial modeling and analysis across diverse business segments.
* Build, maintain, and own bottom-up Go-To-Market planning and forecast models connecting GTM investments, operating expenses, headcount planning, and revenue forecasts.
* Propose and implement strategic solutions to drive key financial metrics in partnership with the GTM organization.
* Guide process improvement, standardization, and reporting enhancements while installing appropriate controls.

### **About you**

* 7+ years of applicable experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic finance.
* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance concepts and accounting principles.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Prior experience with financial and data analytics tools such as Anaplan and Databricks.
* Proven ability to cultivate effective cross-functional relationships with strong planning, communication, and organizational skills.
* Sound business judgment with a track record of translating complex financial analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
* Proactive ownership and a first-principles approach to solving ambiguous problems in a dynamic environment.
* The ideal candidate will be curious, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with excellent analytical and communication skills.
* Prior experience within Product-Led Growth (PLG) or Sales-Led Growth (SLG) technology companies is a plus.
* Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

### **What we'll offer**

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $164,000 - $186,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

* Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
* Career coaching & support
* Inclusive family building benefits
* Long-term savings or retirement plans
* In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

Strong business partnership with ability to work effectively with teams across different time zones

Advanced proficiency in Excel and Keynote  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $140,700 and $211,400, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.description:
About Altais:

At Altais, we’re on a mission to improve the healthcare experience for everyone—starting with the people who deliver it. We believe physicians should spend more time with patients and less time on administrative tasks. Through smarter technology, purpose-built tools, and a team-based model of care, we help doctors do what they do best: care for people.

Altais includes a network of physician-led organizations across California, including Brown & Toland Physicians, Altais Medical Group Riverside, and Family Care Specialists. Together, we’re building a stronger, more connected healthcare system.

**About the Role**

**Are you looking to join a fast-growing, dynamic team?**

We’re a collaborative, purpose-driven group that’s passionate about transforming healthcare from the inside out. At Altais, we support one another, adapt quickly, and work with integrity as we build a better experience for physicians and their patients.

The Senior Financial Analyst will play a key role in supporting financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting activities. This position will serve as a trusted financial partner to operational and business leaders, providing meaningful financial insights to support strategic planning, operational performance, and informed decision making. The ideal candidate combines strong financial and analytical capabilities with a solid understanding of accounting principles and cost allocation methodologies.

**You will focus on:**

* Support the annual operating budget, quarterly forecasts, and long-range planning processes in partnership with business and operational leaders.
* Prepare monthly financial reporting packages, including detailed variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior year.
* Build and maintain financial models to support business cases and scenario planning.
* Partner with Accounting on month-end close and reconciliation of financial results.
* Partner with department leaders to understand business needs, evaluate financial performance, and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* Understand and incorporate industry specific metrics into reports to highlight relevant trends and support fact-based business decisions.

* Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, and automate financial reporting and forecasting processes.
* Support ad hoc analysis and presentations for executive leadership and the Board.

**The Skills, Experience & Education You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in finance, mathematics, actuarial science, statistics, or economics from an accredited program
* 3+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, financial planning and analysis, or a related finance role.
* Experience in the healthcare industry, preferably within a health plan, managed care organization, or medical group.
* Experience with cost allocations, cost accounting, expense distribution methodologies, or departmental cost analysis.
* Demonstrated understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.

* Experience analyzing financial performance, investigating variances, and communicating results to business leaders.
* Proven experience using databases, Word and Access, PowerPoint required. Expert in Microsoft Excel, rudimentary understanding of databases and different data architecture.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* 5+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, financial planning and analysis, or a related finance role.

* Experience with business intelligence tools such as Workday Adaptive Planning
* Experience supporting executive level financial reporting and presentations.

The Compensation for this position is **$75,000 - $90,000/year**

* Excellent medical, vision, and dental coverage
* 401k savings plan with a company match
* Flexible time off and 9 Paid Holidays

We act with empathy and a deep respect for the challenges faced by physicians and their patients. Our work is driven by a genuine commitment to improving lives and ensuring that care is delivered with dignity, understanding, and humanity.

**Community**

We foster a culture of collaboration-with physicians, patients across the healthcare ecosystem, and among our teams. By building strong, trusted relationships, we create a unified community focused on advancing patient care and physician well-being.

**Leadership**

We lead with integrity and vision, setting the standard for excellence in physician support and healthcare innovation. Through collaboration and expertise, we empower others to lead, drive change, and shape the future of care.

**Excellence**

We are relentlessly focused, results-driven, and accountable for delivering measurable value to physicians and the patients they serve. Our high standards reflect our commitment to excellence, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.

**Agility**

We embrace change as a constant and respond swiftly to the evolving needs of the healthcare industry. With flexibility and forward-thinking, we adapt, innovate, and act decisively to keep physicians at the forefront.

jobs.title: FP&A Lead
jobs.description:
Iterable is the AI customer engagement platform, built for enterprise scale, loved by teams, and trusted by global brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box. Our platform empowers organizations to activate customer data from any source, design seamless cross-channel experiences, and optimize engagement with Nova Intelligence, the AI layer of our platform, all with enterprise-grade security and compliance. Today, nearly 1,200 brands across 50+ countries rely on Iterable to drive growth, deepen customer relationships, and deliver joyful customer experiences.

Our success is powered by extraordinary people who bring our core values to life every day: Be an Owner, Growth Mindset, Run as One, and Transparency. And the market has noticed: G2 recognizes Iterable as a Leader globally, spanning the Americas, EMEA, APAC, ANZ, and Latin America, with category leadership in Personalization, Marketing Automation, Push Notifications, and Mobile Marketing, and a 4.5/5-star rating from hundreds of users. Gartner named Iterable a Challenger in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Multichannel Marketing in both 2024 and 2025. We’ve also earned TrustRadius Top Rated honors in 2024 and 2025, were named a TrustRadius Buyer’s Choice for 2026, and were featured in Snowflake’s Modern Marketing Data Stack 2026.

With a global presence that includes offices in San Francisco, Denver, London, Sydney, and Lisbon, plus remote employees worldwide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture and About Us pages. Let’s shape the future of customer engagement together!

This FP&A lead position is a critical and highly visible leadership role within the Iterable finance team that drives integrated financial strategic analysis and consolidation to support department and company-wide planning, forecasting, and performance reporting processes. Reporting to the VP of FP&A, this strategic leader will be essential to corporate forecasting, reporting, and executive decision support while serving as a strategic partner to Research & Development (R&D). You will lead forecasting for product-level revenue and bookings, while partnering closely with Product and Commercial teams on pricing model initiatives and unit economics. Your goal is to bridge our SaaS platform's technical trajectory and financial performance, leading short- and long-term investment strategy while standing at the nexus of AI-driven development—both leveraging cutting-edge AI financial tooling and supporting the future of AI-driven personalized marketing.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a strong track record of leadership in interpreting, analyzing, and communicating complex business issues and driving strategic improvements. Advanced strategic problem-solving, team mentorship, cross-functional prioritization, and rigorous financial rigor are critical. This position offers significant executive exposure and direct influence over core strategic decisions across the business.

The core functions of the role include helping lead the annual operating plan, orchestrating rolling forecasts, driving contingent scenario planning and strategic long-range models, and establishing advanced month-end management reporting—ensuring agility to continuously champion the strategic objectives of Iterable.

**Responsibilities:**

* Be a key driver in company-wide financial statement forecasting and reporting across product-level revenue metrics, bookings, resource allocation, headcount, and OpEx, maintaining full finance ownership for the R&D organization
* Serve as the strategic finance leader for the R&D organization, managing departmental budgets, headcount models, and ROI metrics across technical development initiatives
* Partner closely with the Product and Go-To-Market leadership teams on strategic pricing model initiatives, package architecture, and monetization strategies for new product offerings
* Lead financial oversight for AI-driven platform initiatives, evaluating investment returns on AI development tools as well as unit economics for AI-powered personalized marketing features
* Own the holistic company cost of revenue forecast, partnering with Engineering FinOps to tie platform performance and cloud infrastructure optimization directly to gross margin optimization
* Spearhead executive and Board of Directors presentation materials, creating high-impact dashboards and narrative analyses to articulate corporate strategy and performance
* Leverage modern AI-driven financial planning tools and methodologies to continuous innovate and scale core FP&A processes
* Drive financial risk and opportunity analyses, evaluating scenario modeling to guide senior management decision-making
* Build scalable strategic frameworks in close alignment with Accounting, Product, and Engineering leadership to drive cross-functional efficiency

**We are looking for people who have:**

* BS in Accounting/Finance, related field, or equivalent experience
* 6+ years of progressive financial analysis experience at high-growth SaaS companies, public accounting, or investment banking, with explicit experience leading product-level software finance
* Proven experience building revenue models, evaluating pricing strategy, and forecasting roll-ups by geographies, segments and/or products
* Expertise in quantitative analysis and financial modeling, alongside familiarity with modern AI tools, BI solutions, and G-Suite apps
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with senior C-suite executives (CFO, CTO, CPO), able to drive strategic consensus and execute their priorities with sound judgement
* Strong passion for AI technology trends, AI-powered product development, and adopting next-gen automation tools
* Strong communication, writing, and presentation skills
* Built strong, collaborative relationships with key team members and stakeholde

* Coordinate with the sales team to adjust purchasing strategies.

jobs.description:
### **About Us:**

**How many companies can say they’ve been in business for over 179 years?!**

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the everchanging environments in a fast-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge of technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 42,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!

  

**What’s the role?**

The NPI / Project Buyer is responsible for leading procurement activities for New Product Introduction (NPI), product development, and other cross-functional projects from early development through production release.

This role serves as the primary procurement interface within the project team and is responsible for ensuring supplier, material, cost, and sourcing readiness in alignment with project milestones. The NPI / Project Buyer works closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Operations, Finance, and suppliers to proactively identify and resolve procurement risks that could impact product launch, cost, quality, or schedule.

  

**Sound Interesting?**

**Here’s what you’ll do:**

**NPI & Project Procurement**

* Lead procurement activities for assigned NPI and product-development projects from concept/prototype through production readiness.
* Represent Procurement within cross-functional project teams and ensure purchasing deliverables are integrated into the overall project plan.
* Drive sourcing and material readiness against NPI milestones and production launch requirements.
* Maintain visibility of procurement status, open issues, risks, and critical-path items.

**Supplier & Sourcing Management**

* Manage RFQ activities, supplier evaluations, negotiations, and sourcing recommendations.
* Partner with Strategic Sourcing and Engineering to select suppliers based on cost, quality, capability, lead time, capacity, and supply risk.
* Coordinate supplier readiness for prototypes, pilot builds, qualification, and production ramp.
* Identify long-lead, single-source, capacity, and supplier-related risks and develop appropriate mitigation plans.

**BOM & Material Readiness**

* Review project BOMs and drive sourcing status for purchased components.
* Identify and escalate material shortages, long lead-time items, and sourcing gaps that could impact project schedules.
* Coordinate purchasing activities associated with engineering changes, including ECO/PCO implementation.
* Support accurate material master, purchasing, and sourcing information within SAP/ERP systems.

**Cost Management**

* Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and negotiate commercial terms.
* Track purchased-material cost against project targets.
* Partner with Engineering and suppliers to identify design-to-cost, value-engineering, and cost-reduction opportunities.
* Provide procurement input for forecasting, business cases, and project cost reviews.

**Production Transition**

* Ensure procurement and supplier readiness before transition from NPI into sustaining production.
* Coordinate handoff of suppliers, pricing, lead times, purchasing information, and open risks to operational procurement/planning teams.
* Support stabilization activities during initial production ramp.

**Sound Interesting?**

**Here’s what you’ll do:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, or related field.
* APICS/ASCM, CPSM, or project-management certification is a plus.

**Experience**

* Typically 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, NPI purchasing, project buying, or supply chain.
* Experience supporting new product introduction and product-development projects in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience working with engineering BOMs, drawings/specifications, ECOs/engineering changes, and prototype-to-production transitions.
* Experience managing suppliers through development, qualification, ramp-up, and production readiness.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems, preferably SAP.

**Core Skills / Competencies**

* **NPI Procurement:** Own procurement activities from early development through production release.
* **Project Management:** Manage purchasing milestones, risks, deliverables, and dependencies against the overall NPI schedule.
* **Supplier Readiness:** Drive RFQs, supplier selection, lead-time alignment, capacity/readiness, and material availability.
* **Cost Management:** Develop should-cost/quote comparisons, negotiate pricing, identify cost-reduction opportunities, and track NPI material cost.
* **BOM Management:** Review BOMs for sourcing status, lead times, shortages, cost, and supply risk.
* **Change Management:** Coordinate purchasing implications of ECO/PCO/design changes and ensure suppliers transition correctly.
* **Risk Management:** Identify long-lead, single-source, capacity, quality, obsolescence, and supply-continuity risks early in the project.
* **Cross-functional Leadership:** Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Planning, Quality, Operations, Finance, and suppliers.
* **Production Transition:** Ensure purchasing and supplier readiness before handoff from NPI/project phase into sustaining production.
* **Global Collaboration:** Comfortable working across suppliers and manufacturing teams in multiple regions/time zones.

### **About Us:**

**How many companies can say they’ve been in business for over 179 years?!**

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the everchanging environments in a fast-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge of technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 42,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!

  

**What’s the role?**

The NPI / Project Buyer is responsible for leading procurement activities for New Product Introduction (NPI), product development, and other cross-functional projects from early development through production release.

This role serves as the primary procurement interface within the project team and is responsible for ensuring supplier, material, cost, and sourcing readiness in alignment with project milestones. The NPI / Project Buyer works closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Operations, Finance, and suppliers to proactively identify and resolve procurement risks that could impact product launch, cost, quality, or schedule.

  

**Sound Interesting?**

**Here’s what you’ll do:**

**NPI & Project Procurement**

* Lead procurement activities for assigned NPI and product-development projects from concept/prototype through production readiness.
* Represent Procurement within cross-functional project teams and ensure purchasing deliverables are integrated into the overall project plan.
* Drive sourcing and material readiness against NPI milestones and production launch requirements.
* Maintain visibility of procurement status, open issues, risks, and critical-path items.

**Supplier & Sourcing Management**

* Manage RFQ activities, supplier evaluations, negotiations, and sourcing recommendations.
* Partner with Strategic Sourcing and Engineering to select suppliers based on cost, quality, capability, lead time, capacity, and supply risk.
* Coordinate supplier readiness for prototypes, pilot builds, qualification, and production ramp.
* Identify long-lead, single-source, capacity, and supplier-related risks and develop appropriate mitigation plans.

**BOM & Material Readiness**

* Review project BOMs and drive sourcing status for purchased components.

**Cost Management**

**Production Transition**

* Ensure procurement and supplier readiness before transition from NPI into sustaining production.
* Coordinate handoff of suppliers, pricing, lead times, purchasing information, and open risks to operational procurement/planning teams.
* Support stabilization activities during initial production ramp.

**Sound Interesting?**

**Here’s what you’ll do:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, or related field.
* APICS/ASCM, CPSM, or project-management certification is a plus.

**Experience**

* Typically 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, NPI purchasing, project buying, or supply chain.
* Experience supporting new product introduction and product-development projects in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience working with engineering BOMs, drawings/specifications, ECOs/engineering changes, and prototype-to-production transitions.
* Experience managing suppliers through development, qualification, ramp-up, and production readiness.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems, preferably SAP.

**Core Skills / Competencies**

* **NPI Procurement:** Own procurement activities from early development through production release.
* **Project Management:** Manage purchasing milestones, risks, deliverables, and dependencies against the overall NPI schedule.
* **Supplier Readiness:** Drive RFQs, supplier selection, lead-time alignment, capacity/readiness, and material availability.
* **Cost Management:** Develop should-cost/quote comparisons, negotiate pricing, identify cost-reduction opportunities, and track NPI material cost.
* **BOM Management:** Review BOMs for sourcing status, lead times, shortages, cost, and supply risk.
* **Change Management:** Coordinate purchasing implications of ECO/PCO/design changes and ensure suppliers transition correctly.
* **Risk Management:** Identify long-lead, single-source, capacity, quality, obsolescence, and supply-continuity risks early in the project.
* **Cross-functional Leadership:** Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Planning, Quality, Operations, Finance, and suppliers.
